title: Kissed Char Korean Beef Skewers
description: A solo dinner Korean dish featuring beef, tomatoes, and a char-grill flavor, this recipe is jain-friendly and perfect for a quick meal. The combination of briny and creamy flavors will leave you wanting more.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: sirloin or ribeye, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and brown sugar.
Add the beef to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the beef and tomatoes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with sesame oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
